# Studio Handbook

We are a 40-person product design studio building client work for new-retail brands.
Teams are 5 to 8 people each: Design, Engineering, Product, and GTM.

Our weekly rhythm: a written status update every Friday, biweekly 1:1s, async-first.
The no-surprises norm: problems get named early, directly, and kindly.

Reassignment and a change of scope are both normal, humane tools when the work needs it.
We read a stall as a project problem first — a moving brief, an unclear "done" — not a person problem.
